He is positioned in a brightly lit airport terminal hallway with various shop signs and informational displays visible in the soft-focus background. (2) The camera transitions to directional signs in a clean, minimalist airport concourse. The signs indicate the way to the 'Capsule Hotel' and '9h nine hours'. The environment is characterized by wide white corridors, bright overhead lighting, and functional architectural elements. (3) At the hotel's reception desk, a female staff member wearing a dark shirt and a protective face mask assists guests. A large digital departure board with blue and white text displays flight information in the background. The area is stark white. (4) The scene shifts to a darkened sleeping area where rows of white, glowing capsule pods are stacked. Each pod has a smooth, curved interior and a minimalist design. The man demonstrates the interior, which contains a neatly made bed and a control panel. (5) The video tours the locker room and bathroom facilities. The locker room features grey flooring with large white graphic arrows and icons. The bathroom area is clad in white square tiles and includes a glass-enclosed shower stall. The man crawls into a pod.
